subject: Post-signature ops cadence: migration, canary, and training plan for ZenithPay
messages:
From: Miguel Alvarez <miguel@zenithpay.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-sign - next steps for rollout & canary plan

Tessa / Marissa,

Thanks again — excited to get started. We signed the SOW and have internal alignment on the November window. To move quickly, can you confirm the mutual action plan items you need from us and the timeline you expect for a staged rollout? High level asks from our side:

- We want a 2-stage canary: 2% traffic first week, then 10% second week before full cutover.
- Training for ops & fraud teams: two 90-minute sessions (recorded).
- Data residency: keep EU-origin traffic in EU region (we'll need routing validation).
- Rollback SLAs and measurable acceptance criteria (latency and error budget).

Attached: signed SOW (Zenith_Signed_SOW_v3.pdf).

Can we get a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) and suggested dates by EOD Monday so we can lock internal calendars?

— Miguel
Miguel Alvarez
Head of Platform
ZenithPay
[Attachment: Zenith_Signed_SOW_v3.pdf]
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Alvarez <miguel@zenithpay.com>, Aisha.Patel <aisha.patel@zenithpay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 10:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-sign - next steps for rollout & canary plan

Miguel / Aisha — thanks, got the signed SOW. High level: we propose a 6-week phased plan embedded in a MAP that covers configuration, canary, migration, training, and final cutover. Draft below — this will be uploaded to the shared MAP spreadsheet (MAP_ZENITH_v1.xlsx).

Week 0 (prep, baseline checks) — Nov 15–19
- Exchange final access (service accounts, IAM roles) 
- Confirm data routing rules for EU traffic (Vivek).
- Baseline perf and tokenization checks on a 10k request sample.
- Deliverable: Access matrix + routing test report.

Week 1 (staged canary A) — Nov 22–26
- Canary A: 2% production traffic to Redwood-hosted endpoint; detailed telemetry capture.
- Pre-canary smoke tests (latency, 5xx rates) run by Redwood and Zenith SRE.
- Training session #1 (ops primer) scheduled Nov 23, 11:00–12:30 PT (recorded).
- Deliverable: Canary A runbook + smoke report + training recording.

Week 2 (staged canary B) — Nov 29–Dec 3
- Canary B: raise to 10% if acceptance criteria met (errors <0.5%, p95 latency <300ms).
- Run fraud-team tabletop with synthetic edge cases.
- Deliverable: Canary B acceptance signoff.

Week 3–4 (migration & ramp) — Dec 6–17
- Gradual ramp to 50% then 100% with automated rollback gates. 
- Training session #2 (response playbooks & monitoring) Dec 9, 14:00–15:30 PT.
- Ops runbook handed over to Zenith SOC.

Week 5 (stabilization & retrospective) — Dec 20–24
- Final audits, runbook edits, post-mortem on issues, cost tuning.

Key owners:
- Redwood (Tessa): overall MAP coordination, rollouts, telemetry
- Redwood (Marissa): customer success, training delivery, runbooks
- Redwood (Vivek): routing/regional validation and infra gating
- Redwood (Olga): cutover engineering and rollback implementations
- Zenith (Miguel/Aisha): provide access, accept canary signoffs, coordinate internal comms

Acceptance criteria (short):
- Errors <0.5% sustained across 24h during canary windows
- p95 latency <300ms for critical endpoints
- No functional regressions on 50 canonical prompts used for evals

Attachments: MAP_ZENITH_v1.xlsx (live sheet), canary-checklist.pdf (checklist + automated gating).
Links: https://drive.google.com/zenith/MAP_ZENITH_v1, HubSpot deal attached.

If you confirm the dates above we’ll create calendar invites and a dedicated Slack channel (#zenith-go-live). Also propose a kickoff call Tuesday Nov 16 at 09:00 PT — want to make sure SREs & Ops are present.

Thanks — I’ll upload the MAP and the canary runbook now.

— Tessa Morgan
Sr. Customer Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0198
[Attachment: MAP_ZENITH_v1.xlsx] [Attachment: canary-checklist.pdf]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Alvarez <miguel@zenithpay.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 11:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-sign - next steps for rollout & canary plan

This looks good — two quick notes from CS/ops perspective:

1) Add a 48-hour pre-canary validation window after we hand over credentials. That gives us time to run the 10k sample and confirm no tokenization drift.
2) For training: recommend adding a 30-minute office-hours slot the week after Canary B for any follow-ups.

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet with those rows and ping the SC to set the invites.

Thanks Tessa / Marissa — that schedule looks great and the acceptance criteria make sense. We agree to the 48-hour pre-canary validation window. Two small tweaks:

- Move Training #1 to Nov 24 (11:00–12:30 PT) so more ops folks can join (holiday on the 23rd here).
- Please call out the rollback contact and SLA in the MAP — we need an escalation path that includes a 15-minute response SLA for critical incidents during canary windows.

If you can update the MAP and send calendar invites, we’ll confirm the kickoff for Tue Nov 16 09:00 PT. Looking forward to the Slack channel.

— Miguel
